core.description: Event bus, game state, save/load interfaces

maze.description: Maze layout grid (seeded, closed) and building the 3D maze from kit pieces, lights, occluders

player.description: Character controller: stances, walk/run/jump, collision, third-person camera, hero animation

touch_controls.description: On-screen joystick and buttons that emit the standard input actions

exploration.description: Visited maze cells (fog-of-war state), stored in GameState

minimap.description: Top-left fog-of-war mini-map, large map on tap, player marker

cloud_save.description: Autosave policy and cloud backend (local + fake in sandbox, iCloud on iOS)

game.description: Main scene: composes all modules and owns boot order; no game logic
